changelog: **MARKETING lead page shows no internship panels (#2348):** `/admin/candidates/[id]` gated its offer (`placements`), evaluation (`evaluations`), goals, meeting-cadence, certificate and CV (`mentorship`) panels on nothing, so a MARKETING admin saw an internship certificate generator on every closed sale. The admin layout now hands the capability list it already resolves for the sidebar to a new client `CapabilitiesProvider` (`src/lib/capabilitiesClient.tsx`, `useHasCapability()`), and the page gates the six panels on it. Presentation only; the APIs keep their own gates. The `offers` and `programJourney` LEAK_EXEMPT reasons in `scripts/check-i18n.ts` now say what the code does.

en: Marketing leads no longer show internship panels such as offers, evaluations, goals, the CV or the certificate generator.
tr: Pazarlama lead'lerinde artık teklif, değerlendirme, hedef, CV veya sertifika oluşturucu gibi staj panelleri görünmüyor.
de: Marketing-Leads zeigen keine Praktikums-Bereiche wie Angebote, Bewertungen, Ziele, den Lebenslauf oder den Zertifikatsgenerator mehr.
